features: COMPACT AND PORTABLE DESIGN: The LK-032 Mini Action Camera features a compact handheld design that is easy to carry for travel, outdoor activities, sports and everyday recording.
HD DISPLAY: View your recordings and frame your shots using the built-in display. The screen helps you preview your subject while operating the camera.
ROTATABLE CAMERA HEAD: The camera head supports 180° and 90° rotation, allowing flexible positioning for different shooting angles and recording situations.
NIGHT VISION FUNCTION: Designed with a night vision feature to support recording in low-light environments. Actual visibility and performance depend on lighting conditions and device specifications.
BUILT-IN FILL LIGHT: The integrated fill light helps illuminate nearby subjects in dim environments, making it useful for indoor recording and selected outdoor situations.
1800mAh BATTERY: Equipped with a 1800mAh rechargeable battery for portable use. Actual operating time varies depending on recording settings, display usage and lighting functions.
TYPE-C CHARGING: Features a Type-C charging interface for convenient recharging with a compatible power source and cable.
HANDHELD SPORTS CAMERA: Suitable for everyday moments, travel memories, casual sports recording, family activities and outdoor adventures.
EASY-TO-CARRY FORM FACTOR: Its handheld construction makes it convenient to store in a bag and carry when you want a portable recording device.
VERSATILE EVERYDAY USE: A practical camera option for users looking for a compact device with a display, adjustable camera head, fill light and rechargeable battery in one unit.
description: Capture everyday moments and outdoor adventures with the LK-032 Mini Action Camera. Designed with a compact handheld body, this portable sports camera combines an HD display, a rotatable camera head, night vision functionality and an integrated fill light for versatile recording. The 180°/90° rotatable camera head provides flexible positioning to help you frame subjects from different angles. The built-in display allows you to preview your shots, while the fill light helps illuminate nearby subjects in darker surroundings. Powered by a rechargeable 1800mAh battery and equipped with Type-C charging, the LK-032 is designed for convenient portable use. Take it along for travel, casual sports activities, family moments and everyday video recording.
